g.text: Static and dynamic support under one exit likelihood
Historical data were previously examined; both latent comparators use bootstrap filters without MH.
144 shared synthetic seasons, 24 per condition. r=0.6 is a conditional-score stress test; middle intervals are paired season bootstrap, excluding MC error.
